def transform(grid):
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in cells), max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    # The grid is 180-degree symmetric. Recover the concealed rectangle from
    # the diametrically opposite rectangle, reversing both axes.
    return [[grid[len(grid) - 1 - (r0 + i)][len(grid[0]) - 1 - (c0 + j)]
             for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
